headline: PROP stocks dominate today with KC and UV posting the biggest single‑day gains on heavy volume, while FOOD shows a sharp fall in F&D and a surge in AQUA.
market_take: The property sector led the market, delivering multiple double‑digit price moves and several volume spikes, notably KC (+0.03, +50% vol) and UV (+1.1, +22.22% vol). Food was mixed: F&D dropped 11.48% on negligible volume, whereas AQUA jumped 11.11% with a 4.9σ volume spike. Cons and PF&REIT activity was modest, with STI (CONS) posting a 14.7σ volume surge and TLHPF (PF&REIT) a 8.0σ spike. Recent filings include XBIO’s disposal of a subsidiary and high‑profile connected‑transaction disclosures from SST and ITC.

sector_notes.note: Strong momentum in KC (+50% vol) and UV (+22.22% vol) alongside several price‑gap events (JCK, WIN) and extreme volume spikes in SAMCO (17.5σ) and AWC (6.1σ) suggest heightened trading activity.
AQUA’s 11.11% intraday rise and 4.9σ volume spike contrast with F&D’s 11.48% drop on almost zero volume; XBIO’s 5‑day +50% gain follows recent disposal filings.
STI recorded a 14.7σ volume spike, while APCS opened with a 14.29% gap and PLE fell 11.11% intraday.
TLHPF’s 8.0σ volume surge and QHOP’s 100% price gap highlight unusual activity; SSTRT also showed a 4.2σ volume spike.
